findings.claim: 2025-05-29 Synopsys received a BIS letter imposing a license requirement on certain EDA exports to China; it halted new China orders; restrictions were lifted in July 2025.
findings.source: Synopsys FY2025 ARS (SEC) / TrendForce / DCD search summaries

findings.claim: FY2025 annual report says Synopsys expects a challenging near-term environment, including in China, due to macroeconomic factors and Trade Restrictions.

Feb 2026 (exact day not in snippet): Synopsys guided Q2 revenue $2.23-2.28B, below consensus $2.24B, citing China export restrictions preventing customers from starting new design projects; shares fell >5% after hours.
findings.source: Techleap feed / Yahoo Finance summary of Synopsys guidance

findings.claim: China customers were about 10% of quarterly revenue as of quarter ending April 2025 (third-party summary).
findings.source: Visible Alpha, Synopsys to see China revenue drop 16% YOY amid US export curbs

reg_tariff_export.note: No tariff/Section 232-specific results found (software, no goods tariff evidence). No primary 2026 Federal Register rule found; current EDA control status unverified. Dates for Feb 2026 and ARS are approximate.
